paragraph1: I'm Kelly Marie, a BACP-registered psychotherapist with years of clinical experience working with individuals, couples, young people and organisations. I am a proud advocate for wellbeing and mental health awareness.
paragraph2: My practice is grounded in psychodynamic theory – drawing on how early relational experiences and unconscious patterns shape our present-day emotional lives. Working alongside integrative and trauma-informed approaches, I offer a thoughtful, evidence-based and confidential service that's tailored to your clinical needs.
paragraph3: I specialise in workplace therapy and wellbeing, working with organisations. As a contracted therapist within an organisation, I work closely with HR and management teams to prioritise mental health and wellbeing in the workplace. This is to ensure that employees who may benefit from my services are referred promptly and given the right support.
